title: Supervisora de modelagem
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Modelagem para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento técnico do setor, garantindo a assertividade das modelagens e o alinhamento entre criação, pilotagem e produção. Esse(a) profissional terá papel estratégico no processo produtivo, assegurando qualidade, vestibilidade e viabilidade das peças.


Responsabilidades:

Gerir o setor de modelagem, orientando a equipe de modelistas no desenvolvimento das atividades, definição de prioridades e supervisão das entregas.

Atuar como porta-voz do setor, assegurando a comunicação eficaz entre pilotagem, engenharia de modelagem e corte para produção.

Interpretar fichas técnicas e orientações dos estilistas, garantindo maior assertividade já na primeira peça piloto.

Desenvolver modelagens no sistema Audaces Moldes, considerando estética, vestibilidade, conforto, caimento e viabilidade produtiva.

Alimentar o sistema ISA com as modelagens e orientar as modelistas quanto ao correto abastecimento.

Acompanhar e orientar pilotistas na confecção das peças piloto, solucionando dúvidas para reduzir ajustes posteriores.

Participar de provas de roupas com os estilistas, avaliando tecnicamente as peças e sugerindo melhorias.

Realizar gradação das modelagens aprovadas por meio do Audaces Moldes, garantindo correta adaptação e padronização dos tamanhos.


Formação:

Ensino Médio completo.

Graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada um diferencial.

Cursos específicos em modelagem.


Experiência profissional:

Vivência no setor de modelagem em fábrica de roupas.

Vivência em modelagem de malharia e tecido plano.

Domínio do sistema Audaces Moldes para desenvolvimento de modelagem.

Experiência em encaixe e aproveitamento de tecido.


Conhecimentos técnicos:

Audaces Moldes.

Conhecimentos avançados em modelagem, tecidos, malhas e acabamentos.

Capacidade de interpretar fichas técnicas de desenvolvimento dos estilistas.


Envie seu currículo para:

Boa Sorte!

title: Estagiário de Engenharia de Projetos e Processos
description:
CONHEÇA UM POUCO SOBRE O GROUPE SEB!


Facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.


Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.


Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.


Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.


Identificou-se com nosso negócio e valores?


Então venha contribuir e deixar sua marca na história da SEB!


RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Elaboração de documentos de processo/projeto;
  • Criação de rotinas de produção;
  • Participação em projetos de melhoria;
  • Cronoanálise de postos de produção;
  • Suporte nos projetos de concepção;
  • Controle de custo do departamento;
  • Interface com Engenharia de Produto, Produção e Projeto;
  • Suporte em análises de processo e construção de relatório técnico;
  • Acompanhamento de produtos novos em linha de produção;



REQUISITOS:


Educação:

  • Cursando Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Produção ou Engenharias Correlatas com conclusão prevista a partir de 2028.


Conhecimentos:

  • Pacote Office Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Inglês Básico.
  • Desejável conhecimentos em ferramentas digitais (PowerBI, Automate, Apps, entre outros)


Competências:

  • Autonomia;
  • Adaptabilidade e Proatividade;
  • Perfil Analítico;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e apresentação;
  • Mentalidade técnica e grande atenção aos detalhes.
  • Bom relacionamento entre equipes;


Necessário residir em Barra Mansa, Volta Redonda, Resende ou Itatiaia.

description:

Buscamos criar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde pessoas de todas as origens sejam tratadas com igualdade, respeitadas e valorizadas por quem são. O sucesso de nossos colaboradores é o nosso sucesso.


Sobre a Função

Responsabilidades:

Qualificações:

title: Bolsista Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - Lopes Alimentos - Mapeamento e Gestão de Processos
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:


A história da Lopes se entrelaça com a trajetória de seus fundadores, João e Luzia. Em 1988, movidos pelo desejo de oferecer melhores condições de vida à família, iniciaram suas atividades no ramo da alimentação com um bar e restaurante. Desde então, o negócio sempre foi conduzido em família, passando também aos filhos do casal.

Em 1993, a Lopes deu início às atividades em Rebouças, já oferecendo serviços de padaria, confeitaria e lanchonete. Com o tempo, expandiu sua estrutura, agregando um restaurante moderno e aconchegante.

Com o propósito constante de servir em abundância, priorizando qualidade e higiene, João e Luzia dedicaram-se incansavelmente ao crescimento do empreendimento. Essa visão de futuro levou à necessidade de investir em gestão de processos e em uma cozinha industrial, pilares essenciais para sustentar o aumento da produção e a continuidade da expansão.


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Alimentos, Administração e áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Mapeamento e Gestão por Processos


Principais Atividades:

  • Diagnósticos do cenário atual da empresa;
  • Mapeamento e gestão por processos;
  • Fluxograma;
  • Controles e registros de documentos produzidos na execução do projeto;
  • Atualização de documentos;
  • Conversa e convívio direto com os setores de produção.


Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos

  • Visão sistêmica e domínio em mapeamento e gestão por processos, fluxograma, controles e conhecimento de ferramentas práticas para transcrição e armazenamento desses processos;
  • Conhecimento em Lean e metodologias de gestão de processos;
  • Experiência profissional em áreas organizacionais e industriais com foco na produção de alimentos e gestão;
  • Experiência com mapeamento de processos.


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais

  • Compreender a importância do projeto “Mapeamento e Gestão por Processo” para a empresa, garantindo engajamento e significado a todas as partes envolvidas;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões baseado em dados, desenvolvendo ferramentas para avaliação de indicadores de desempenho e aplicando metodologias estruturadas;
  • Ter comportamento flexível e boa comunicação, atuando diretamente com líderes e setores e criando ambientes de troca sólidos e acessíveis para coleta de dados;
  • Atuar com rigor metodológico, organização e clareza na condução das etapas do projeto, cumprindo prazos e metas estipulados.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial


Formato de trabalho : Presencial (algumas vezes pode atuar no formato teletrabalho)


Local: Rebouças/PR (Cidade Rebouças no interior do Paraná)


Soft Skills: Trabalho em Equipe, Pensamento Crítico, Criatividade, Organização, Ética e Responsabilidade.


Cortesia: oferecem refeição no local

description:

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!

Para nós, diversidade, equidade e inclusão são dimensões do mesmo esforço para transformar o mundo e nos transformar; para ter equipes que sejam reflexo das realidades dos países onde operamos e nos aproximar dos nossos consultores, representantes e consumidores.

title: Líder Florestal - Patrimonial
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.


As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).


Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • Liderar as atividades das equipes patrimoniais em fazendas florestais.

  • Controlar e reportar ocorrências patrimoniais, investigando situações de risco e propondo medidas corretivas.
  • Implementar e garantir a aplicação de normas e procedimentos de segurança patrimonial, incluindo treinamentos preventivos.
  • Apoiar auditorias, fiscalizações e demais processos internos relacionados à segurança patrimonial.
  • Manter interface direta com supervisores florestais para alinhamento das demandas operacionais.
  • Apontar desvios da área patrimonial (ocorrências, tempo de resposta, rondas
  • executadas, entre outros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional da Arauco.



Requisitos:


  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo (desejável Curso Técnico Florestal ou Superior em Engenharia Florestal).
  • Experiência: mínimo de 2 anos na área florestal/patrimonial, preferencialmente em operações florestais.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vigilância patrimonial e prevenção de perdas.
  • Conhecimento em pragas e doenças florestais do eucalipto e execução de ações de Combate.

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

Do you thrive on delivering high-energy, high-impact, active learning experiences that make the participants the stars of the show?

Your main focus will be to drive transformation and achieve results for learners and clients by delivering tailored content and RAIN Group IP through training, coaching, and reinforcement, utilizing a variety of delivery mediums.

You'll work within our client and product teams and be responsible for partnering directly with clients to execute the delivery of our programs so they achieve mutually agreed client results. This includes the tailoring of content, and the delivery and facilitation of sessions, coaching, and reinforcement.


You'll be expected to

· Drive client transformation and results by delivering world-class programming

· Project manage client engagements to ensure seamless execution, custom design, and details managed/produced on time and on budget

· Master IP knowledge, and be a source for others as an IP expert

· Meet expected KPI for client feedback on programming and facilitation

· Collaborate with internal teams on behalf of the client, accessing project management, development, content, technology to enable successful deliveries

· Maintain professional client and internal communication at the highest level

· Support sales or large-scale projects as needed

· Provide feedback to sales, product, marketing, and client results teams as needed


Desired Skills, Attributes, and Competencies:

Successful candidates are innately curious and creative thinkers with motivational energy who are comfortable working as part of a team. Training facilitators must have a sound understanding of adult learning theory and the use of experiential learning techniques.


Additional requirements include:

· Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese

· Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree

· Training facilitation experience and stellar references

· Demonstrated experience selling and/or leading sales teams

· Outstanding group facilitation and presentation skills

· Working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and modern collaboration software

· Exceptional oral and written communication skills

· Knowledge of the instructional design process

· Ability to adapt and relate to all levels of leadership, management, and employees with ease and enthusiasm

· Ability to ramp up quickly on specific verticals and organizations

· Open to coaching and feedback

· Willingness to travel extensively domestically and open to international travel

· Reasonably convenient access to a major airport hub

· Availability and interest in training in the range of 2-10 days per month (exclusive of travel) depending upon demand


About Us

RAIN Group is a global sales training and consulting company that helps leading organizations improve sales results. Founded in 2002, we are experiencing significant growth and have established a reputation as a world-leader in sales training and consulting.


We take our company values seriously: Client Results, Excellence @ Speed, Openness, and Commitment to the Success of Others.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Gerente Sr. em Relações Sindicais
description:
Somos PepsiCo


Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados(as) com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.


Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI ™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI® e muitas outras.


Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.


Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs


A Oportunidade


O Gerente Sr. de Relações Sindicais desempenha um papel crucial na definição e execução da estratégia de relações sindicais da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods. Esse cargo é responsável por desenvolver uma estrutura abrangente que esteja alinhada aos objetivos operacionais e à força de trabalho da PepsiCo do Brasil Foods, garantindo uma abordagem proativa e estratégica em relações sindicais. Atuando como principal negociador em negociações coletivas e interações com Conselhos de Trabalho, Sindicatos e representantes dos empregados, o Diretor de Relações Trabalhistas representa os interesses da PBF enquanto promove relações produtivas e positivas.


Sindicatos e empregados sindicalizados:Gerenciar relações com aprox. 80 sindicatos e conduzir mais de 330 negociações, representando 100% dos empregados sindicalizados, de forma a gerenciar eficazmente os processos de negociação coletiva. Melhorar as relações com o Ministério do Trabalho e outras autoridades.


Seu impacto


Negociação com sindicatos de Vendedores, Comércio, Motoristas e Operações (~150/ano);

Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais relacionados a todas as negociações coletivas;

Relacionamento com o Ministério do Trabalho e com os principais líderes sindicais, a fim de garantir negociações coletivas eficazes.


Quem estamos buscando?


  • Ensino Superior completa em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida vivência com relações sindicais e negociações.
  • Inglês/espanhol - diferencial
  • Excelente habilidade analítica e organizacional, incluindo definição de prioridades e tomada de decisões;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de iniciativa e de priorizar a carga de trabalho, sendo capaz de entregar resultados sob pressão e dentro de prazos definidos;
  • Trabalho em equipe, com habilidade para liderar e influenciar.


Se esta oportunidade for do seu interesse, incentivamos que se candidate, mesmo que não atenda 100% dos requisitos.


O que você pode esperar da gente?


Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.
  • Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.
  • Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).
  • Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.
  • Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.
  • E como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.


Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

title: Coordenador(a) de FP&A
description:
A TIMBRO é uma empresa em amplo crescimento, com grande solidez financeira, gestão altamente eficaz de processos e comprometimento total com os negócios que transaciona.


Temos um objetivo importante para ser conquistado: Inspirar pessoas a fazer negócios que movam o mundo. Nosso nome representa a nossa Cultura e Valores : voltada para resultados, eficiência, foco no cliente interno e externo.


“Na Timbro valorizamos as diferenças e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva que busca a equidade”.


Estamos aqui para: Ver além e realizar mais!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de FP&A para liderar a gestão financeira e de performance da nossa operação de importação e comercialização de aços. Esta posição é estratégica para garantir o acompanhamento próximo do negócio, trazendo visibilidade, confiabilidade e insights que suportem a tomada de decisão. Será responsável por coordenar um analista sênior, interagir constantemente com a área de negócios e desenvolver controles, processos e indicadores para dar suporte a uma operação complexa que envolve importação, estoque e vendas no mercado nacional, bem como operações de exportação de minérios de aço e manganês.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão da equipe: liderar e desenvolver um analista sênior, garantindo entrega de análises consistentes e dentro dos prazos;
  • Exposição cambial e financeira: monitorar riscos de câmbio da operação de aço (exposição natural, NDFs, marcação a mercado) e acompanhar a efetividade dos hedges contratados;
  • Gestão de estoques: controlar o aging, volumes, custos médios e variações, além de realizar marcação a mercado e análises de giro e rentabilidade por produto;
  • Apuração de resultado gerencial: elaborar e validar o resultado da operação, garantindo conciliação com a contabilidade e confiabilidade das informações para as DFs;
  • Análise de performance: desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs do negócio (margem, rentabilidade, giro de estoque, exposição financeira, etc.), propondo melhorias e alternativas de otimização;
  • Interação com áreas de negócio: atuar como parceiro da operação de aço, garantindo alinhamento com a equipe comercial e logística quanto a margens, custos e riscos;
  • Projetos e melhorias: implementar novos controles e processos em conjunto com a controladoria corporativa, promovendo maior robustez e agilidade na gestão;


Requisitos necessários para essa função:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas; pós-graduação/MBA será um diferencial;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento sólido em operações de comércio exterior e em mercado financeiro/cambial (exposição, NDFs, hedge);
  • Forte domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados: Excel avançado, Power BI e Power Query; conhecimento em SQL é diferencial;
  • Capacidade analítica, visão crítica e habilidade de transformar dados em insights acionáveis.
  • Boa comunicação e postura de business partner, capaz de dialogar com áreas comerciais e diretoria;
  • Perfil mão na massa, com visão estratégica e, ao mesmo tempo, disposição para construir e aprimorar processos ainda incipientes;

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Geotechnical Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Geotechnical Engineer to lead quality assurance, compliance, and inspection efforts for civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia . This hands-on role focuses on geotechnical engineering practices—earthwork, excavation, backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation—ensuring strict adherence to US standards (USACE, EM 385-1-1), contractual obligations, and international codes (ISO, BS, EU). The Engineer will oversee testing, design, and maintenance of geotechnical elements in roads, bridges, and buildings.


Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement Project-Specific Quality Control Plans (QCP) in compliance with contract specifications, US Standards, and applicable international standards (e.g., ISO, USACE, EM 385-1-1), with a strong focus on geotechnical elements such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation.
  • Review design documents, technical specifications, and project plans to identify quality requirements, using computer-aided design (CAD) software and engineering principles to ensure civil/geotechnical infrastructure (e.g., roads, bridges, buildings) meets US Standards.
  • Perform daily inspections and surveillance of construction activities, including geotechnical assessments for earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, utility installation, concrete/steel testing, and site stability evaluations, to ensure compliance with approved plans, procedures, and project specifications.
  • Lead and Support the Three-Phase Control Process (Preparatory, Initial, and Follow-Up) and document all phases of work, with an emphasis on geotechnical risks, mitigations, and responsible charge oversight for earthwork and related activities.
  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), implement corrective/preventive actions, and track resolution for issues related to geotechnical engineering, including excavation stability, backfilling compaction, pavement integrity, and utility installation.
  • Coordinate and supervise third-party testing laboratories, ensuring timely submittal and approval of test results for geotechnical materials (e.g., soil, aggregates) to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Oversee quality aspects of the construction, maintenance, and repair of civil infrastructure projects on Diego Garcia, with responsible charge for geotechnical components such as earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with construction plans, specifications, and safety protocols.
  • Train and guide site personnel on quality standards, inspection protocols, documentation requirements, and geotechnical best practices, including safe handling of earthwork and utility-related tasks.
  • Maintain detailed QC documentation, including daily reports, inspection checklists, material submittals, test records, and CAD-generated plans for geotechnical-focused projects.
  • Interface with the client, project management, subcontractors, regulatory agencies, engineers, architects, and contractors on quality and geotechnical issues, providing technical support in a responsible charge role to ensure successful project completion.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the quality system, recommend process improvements, and conduct/participate in internal audits while facilitating external quality audits as required.
  • Inspect civil infrastructure projects to ensure ongoing compliance with US Standards, project specifications, security, and safety procedures, including work in extreme weather conditions, with a focus on geotechnical stability and performance.


Qualifications & Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Licensed and registered as a Civil Engineer or Geotechnical Engineer in the United States of America (e.g., Professional Engineer (PE) certification).
  • At least 5 years of licensed experience, of which at least 3 years must be in responsible charge in geotechnical engineering practice or the type of work being performed on this project (e.g., earthwork, excavation, filling and backfilling, pavement construction, and utility installation).
  • QC certification for relevant industries (e.g., geotechnical testing).
  • Significant material testing expertise to BS, EU, and US Standards.
  • Knowledge of US construction standards and codes (e.g., USACE, CQC).
  • Experience with government contracting, security, and safety procedures.
  • Hands-on experience in External & Internal Quality Audit Programmes, ISO Quality Management System, and quality tools/methodologies.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for designing and implementing robust data pipelines. Must maintain high data quality and security in cloud environments, automating tasks with Python and Bash scripting, and continuously research new technologies to enhance scalability. This role focuses on the development and implementation of data engineering solutions that enhance data warehousing capabilities and maintain legacy and new systems.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement data pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Develop and maintain ETL processes using tools such as Fivetran, Matillion, SSIS, SSAS, SSRSand Snowflake Dataflow on AWS.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval by designing and implementing data partitioning, indexing, and compression strategies.
  • Build and maintain data processing infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.
  • Collaborate with business and analysts to ensure data quality, accuracy, and availability for analysis and reporting.
  • Manage and lead Complex System Design, Integration and Development.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Implement security and access controls to protect sensitive data in cloud-based environments.
  • Automate data processing tasks using scripting languages such as Python or Bash
  • Research and evaluate new technologies and tools to improve data processing efficiency and scalability.
  • Mentor and train junior data engineers and provide technical guidance to cross-functional teams.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Computer Science, Engineering or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience developing, validating, and implementing data warehouses, data systems or cloud-based data solutions.
  • Experience in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing and legacy systems.
  • Experience with multiple data modeling approaches, SQL, and scripting programming languages like Python and PowerShell.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Good understanding of OLAP Cubes, Dimensional model.
  • Ability to lead and coach team members.
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder engagement abilities; driving results through innovation, process improvement and creativity.
  • Able to prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated understanding of agile methodologies, QA practices and user experience, with strong digital & technical skills.
  • Experienced with collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, Lucid Chart;).
  • Strong understanding of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, HANA, Snowflake.
  • Experience with traditional on-prem virtual and physical infrastructure, as well as cloud-based environments, preferably AWS.
  • Excellent understanding of Windows, and Linux based infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of various tools, open-source technologies, and cloud services

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Trace Finance

Trace Finance empowers global payment enterprises to seamlessly move money across borders and access stablecoins with ease. With over $5 billion USD in processed volume, we provide the infrastructure that enables instant settlement, regulatory clarity, and best-in-class FX and crypto on/off ramps. We're building the future of cross-border payments and digital asset infrastructure.

The Role

We're seeking a talented mid-level Platform Engineer (DevOps Engineer) to join our infrastructure team. While we prefer candidates who can work from our office for better collaboration and team integration, we also offer remote work flexibility. You'll be instrumental in building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and automation systems that power our global payment platform. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical infrastructure that supports billions in transaction volume and ensures 24/7 availability for our financial services.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS to support high-volume financial transactions
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable software deployments
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent, reproducible environments
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability
  • Automate operational tasks and improve deployment processes to increase team efficiency
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize application performance and reliability
  • Ensure security best practices across all infrastructure components
  • Participate in on-call rotation to maintain 24/7 system availability
  • Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in production environments
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles
  • Strong problem-solving skills and systematic approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to work independently whether in office or remote settings
  • Passion for automation, reliability, and operational excellence
  • Interest in financial technology and innovation
  • PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) registration or willingness to obtain
Required Technical Skills
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Container Orchestration: Proven expertise with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for managing cloud resources
  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Scripting: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Containerization: Solid understanding of Docker and container best practices
  • Networking: Understanding of networking concepts, load balancers, DNS, and security groups
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Basic English proficiency (required for documentation and team communication)
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
  • Experience with microservices architecture and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Database administration experience (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis)
  • Message queue systems (AWS SNS, SQS, Kafka)
  • Security and compliance tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, security scanning)
  • Experience with financial systems and high-availability requirements
  • Advanced Kubernetes features (operators, custom resources, Helm)
  • GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Performance tuning and capacity planning
  • Cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure
  • Intermediate English proficiency
Essential Soft Skills
  • Proactive mindset - Identify potential issues before they become problems
  • Self-learner - Stay current with evolving DevOps tools and practices
  • Critical thinking - Analyze complex systems and design elegant solutions
  • Self-management - Prioritize work effectively and manage your time independently
  • Team collaboration - Work effectively with engineering teams across different time zones
  • Commitment - Dedicated to maintaining system reliability and meeting SLAs
  • Versatility - Adapt to new technologies and changing infrastructure needs
  • Communication - Clearly document and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
What We Offer
  • Flexible work arrangement (office preferred, remote possible)
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge fintech and blockchain infrastructure
  • Build and maintain systems that process billions in transaction volume
  • Collaborative, innovative team environment with strong engineering culture
  • Professional growth opportunities in cloud technologies and DevOps practices
  • Exposure to both traditional finance and cryptocurrency ecosystems
  • Impact the reliability and scalability of global payment infrastructure
  • Work with modern tools and technologies in a forward-thinking organization


Ready to build world-class infrastructure? Join us at Trace Finance and be part of the team that powers the future of cross-border transactions and digital assets.

title: Financial Controller - LATAM
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Consultor Desenvolvimento Produtos
description:
Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!


Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!


Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse , junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!


DESCRIÇÃO DO TRABALHO

Estamos procurando um Consultor de Produtos Sênior para atuar com o desenvolvimento de produtos e assegurar alto retorno de investimento (ROI). O profissional deverá traduzir ideias em estratégias e recursos e acompanhar o desenvolvimento de produtos do início ao fim.

Um consultor de produtos sênior é um profissional que atua no desenvolvimento de projetos, identificando problemas, propondo soluções e gerenciando a relação com os departamentos do cliente. Desempenhando um papel extremamente ativo no desenvolvimento de um projeto: formulando hipóteses, propondo soluções aos problemas e executando demandas.

Para ser bem-sucedido nessa função, é preciso ser um líder perceptivo, criativo e capaz de resolver problemas. Se, além disso, você tiver uma competência excepcional para conhecer quais ideias terão ou não sucesso, gostaríamos de conhecê-lo.

Inglês e espanhol serão diferenciais importantes.


ATIVIDADES A SEREM EXECUTADAS:

  • Apoiar estudos e análises sobre criptoativos, stablecoins, CBDCs e tecnologias blockchain.
  • ·Contribuir com benchmarks, pesquisas de mercado e tendências regulatórias.
  • Participar da elaboração de documentos técnicos e apresentações para áreas internas.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, tecnologia e jurídico em iniciativas relacionadas a ativos digitais.
  • Monitorar KPIs e métricas de produtos digitais em desenvolvimento ou operação.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Formação superior completa (preferencialmente em Economia, Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência prévia com criptoativos, blockchain ou produtos financeiros digitais.
  • Boa capacidade de análise e comunicação.
  • Conhecimento básico de regulação financeira e inovação tecnológica.

REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS PARA INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Certificações ou cursos em blockchain, criptoativos ou inovação financeira.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel, Power BI, SQL, etc.).
  • Participação em comunidades ou eventos do ecossistema cripto.
  • ·Inglês e espanhol intermediário.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.

title: Solution Architect Specialist
description:
Job Title – Solution Architect Specialist

TITTLE: Solution Architect Specialist (D2)

Location: São Paulo – Villa Lobos

Flexible Working / Hybrid – Office and Remote combination


Why join BT International?

BT International is looking for an experienced Solution Architect Specialist to join our Customer Solutions & Design team. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in architecting complex, high-impact solutions for our global customers — and ensuring that what we sell is what we deliver, right the first time.


Why this role matters

As a Solution Architect Specialist, you’ll act as the trusted advisor for strategic customers, shaping innovative solutions across multiple technology domains — from networking and cloud to security, collaboration, and AI. You’ll be accountable for the end-to-end solution lifecycle, working closely with sales, delivery, and service teams to drive exceptional outcomes.

This is more than a technical role — it’s a leadership position where your expertise, collaboration, and commercial acumen will directly influence BT International’s growth and reputation.


What you’ll do

  • Lead solution architecture for complex, customized, multi-technology environments — ensuring they are technically sound, commercially viable, and executable.
  • Translate customer business requirements into fit-for-purpose, scalable solutions that balance feasibility, cost, and profitability.
  • Own the solution lifecycle across pre-sales, proposal development, and early delivery, ensuring alignment with scope, risk management, and governance standards.
  • Partner with sales teams to develop compelling proposals, statements of work, and customer contracts.
  • Represent BT in strategic customer meetings, presenting solutions with impact and confidence at executive level.
  • Collaborate with virtual cross-functional teams (sales, bid, product, delivery, and service design) to ensure end-to-end solution clarity and deliverability.
  • Assess and manage scope changes during delivery to maintain alignment with cost, time, and quality objectives.
  • Contribute to BT’s market leadership by developing reusable solution components and accelerators, and by staying ahead of emerging trends (e.g., AI, advanced cloud, and digital workplace solutions).

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience (10+ years) in pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex IT environments.
  • Track record of success in large, global sales opportunities, supporting revenue growth and delivery excellence.
  • Strong expertise in multi-domain solution design across:
  • Digital Infrastructure (Cloud, WAN, SDWAN, LAN, WiFi, Security)
  • Digital Workplace (Collaboration, Contact Centres)
  • Emerging technologies (AI, automation)
  • Skilled in proposal development, estimation, and scope definition, with the ability to identify risks and dependencies.
  • Strong commercial acumen — able to balance customer needs with business objectives, protect scope, and identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills; confident engaging with senior executives and simplifying complex concepts.
  • A leadership mindset: proactive, accountable, and able to guide cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • A continuous improvement approach: curious, innovative, and passionate about raising the bar in solution quality and delivery.


What you’ll get

  • The chance to work with a global portfolio of strategic customers.
  • A hybrid, flexible work environment.
  • Competitive package with opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • Be part of a team where things just work… Better on BT.

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning

*Please note that this is a temporary position to cover a maternity leave.*


Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Coordenador de Controladoria
description:
SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Nosso propósito é facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.

Identificou-se com nosso negócio e valores?

Então venha contribuir e deixar sua marca na história da SEB!


Missão:

Coordenar o processo de geração, análise e reporte de informações gerenciais da controladoria atendendo aos parâmetros do Grupo SEB, bem como análises de viabilidade financeira de projetos, visando contribuir para a apuração dos resultados corporativos e subsidiar o processo de tomada de decisões.


Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Coordenar o fluxo de informações internas, para que os relatórios solicitados pela matriz sejam devidamente preenchidos e enviados, no prazo estabelecido;
  • Receber os dados consolidados da matriz, formatar, analisar e reportá-los;
  • Administrar informações e prazos para a execução de orçamentos;
  • Elaborar e emitir relatórios internos sobre os resultados alcançados pela empresa (local e/ou consolidado);
  • Apoiar a Gerência de Controladoria na compilação das informações financeiras;
  • Elaborar e emitir apresentações e demonstrações que atendam às demandas da Gerência de Controladoria ou eventuais solicitações internacionais;
  • Criar e manter o cadastro de produtos que irão fazer parte do fluxo de informações do grupo;
  • Desenvolver sistemáticas apropriadas à elaboração do budget pelos diversos setores/usuários;
  • Coordenar junto aos demais departamentos da empresa as premissas, prazos e metas orçamentárias para que os orçamentos possam ser elaborados;
  • Efetuar cálculos específicos necessários para elaboração do orçamento;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de novos processos para atender às novas demandas de informações financeiras da empresa.


O que buscamos?

  • Formação superior, graduação em Administração de Empresas ou Economia.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em Controladoria Financeira ou atividades compatíveis;
  • Idiomas: Inglês (mínimo nível avançado)
  • Conhecimento em mercado de Câmbio e paridades monetárias;
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos de informática com conhecimentos avançados em Excel;
  • Conhecimento em métodos de custeio, normas e procedimentos contábeis;

title: Legal Contract Lawyer/ Brazil / VBET
description:
About the Company

VBET is an award-winning sports betting and gaming operator with 20 years of experience in the industry powered in-house by BetConstruct. We have shifted from a start-up to an extensive international company holding over 10 licenses and operating in over 120 countries. VBET’s mission is to give our customers the best betting and gaming experience in a safe and secure environment.


About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Contract Manager (Legal) to take full ownership of our third-party vendor contracts. This operational role requires a pragmatic, hands-on professional who can quickly standardize our contracting process and mitigate commercial risks.

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time (on-site)

Reports to: Local CEO, Global Head of Legal Department


Key Responsibilities

  • Contract Standardization: Assess the current state of vendor agreements (approx. 50-60 external contractors) and develop several streamlined, legally sound contract templates for routine operational and marketing expenditures
  • Template Ownership: Create and manage a library of standardized contract documents, ensuring ease of use for internal departments (e.g., Marketing, Operations) to significantly reduce time-to-signature
  • Contract Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end lifecycle for new and existing contracts, including drafting, execution, revisions, amendments, and renewals
  • Risk Mitigation: Conduct initial risk assessments on existing and proposed contracts, identifying crucial clauses and necessary adjustments before execution
  • Cross-Functional Support: Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams (especially Marketing) to provide guidance on contract preparation and compliance
  • Internal Alignment: Ensure all regional contract needs and changes are aligned with the new directorate structure being established in each territory
  • Legal Collaboration: Collaborate with the centralized legal team for review of complex international agreements and high-risk contracts


✅ Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Proven experience (3+ years) as a Contract Manager, Commercial Manager, Lawyer, Legal Counsel or similar role focused on high-volume contract administration
  • Experience working within the iGaming or betting sector is highly preferred
  • Strong, demonstrable knowledge and hands-on experience in contract management, drafting, and interpretation
  • Proven ability to implement new processes and templates that improve efficiency and significantly speed up internal workflows
  • Comfortable working autonomously and serving as the primary commercial/contractual expert within the local team
  • Fluent English and Brazilian Portuguese are mandatory

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

- Demonstrar proatividade e adaptabilidade para lidar com situações imprevistas.

- Ser resiliente e capaz de superar desafios para garantir o sucesso dos alunos.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x na semana presenciais);

description:

Além disso, terá papel fundamental no fornecimento de informações gerenciais que permitam antecipar riscos e identificar oportunidades, apoiando a tomada de decisão e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.

  • Elaborar processo de revisão mensal de Vendas e Resultado, LBE (Latest Best Estimate), (Actual x Budget x LBE);

  • Elaborar indicadores mensais das áreas e apresentá-los sempre que necessário;
  • Propor alternativas de melhoria nos processos da área com o objetivo de otimizar o tempo e processos;
  • Formalizar os processos da área e divulgar às áreas relacionadas para que cumpram prazos e políticas;
  • Manter as plataformas da empresa atualizadas de acordo com a necessidade e diretrizes de Compliance;
  • Exercer demais atividades relacionadas à função de acordo com a necessidade da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou Engenharia;
  • Experiência preferencialmente nas áreas de FP&A e/ou áreas correlatas (controladoria);
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Pacote Office avançado.
